messages:
Emma (ACME): Hey team — our downstream JSON parser is failing when using structured output. It works for small inputs but breaks when we include Windows paths in a code block. Repro below, sending request id req_0a1b2c3d and model `rw-instruct-1`. Using streaming=true.

Emma (ACME): Request payload:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model":"rw-instruct-1",
  "structured": true,
  "stream": true,
  "input": "Create a JSON object with fields: {\"path\": \"C:\\Users\\bob\\project\\file.txt\", \"note\": \"line1\nline2\"}"
}
```

Emma (ACME): What we get back (truncated):
```
data: {"delta":"{\"path\": \"C:\\Users\\bob\\project\\fi"
...chunk boundary...
data: {"delta":"le.txt\", \"note\": \"line1\\nline2\"}
```

Emma (ACME): Our parser sees `"{\"path\": "C:\Users\bob\project\file.txt", ...` and fails with JSON error: Unexpected token U in string at position 12

Mira - Support: sorry about that, looking. Can you paste the full request_id and the first/last message timestamps? I'll grab logs. :eyes:

Emma (ACME): req_0a1b2c3d, first ts 2598765432, last ts 2598765460

John (eng-runtime): likely chunk boundary is splitting an escape sequence so the backslash count ends up odd. Streaming emitter might be incorrectly concatenating without preserving escape context. Can you confirm you use our JS SDK or raw HTTP?

Emma (ACME): raw HTTP curl from Windows machine. We saw it only when path contains multiple backslashes and when `\n` occurs in a value.

Mira - Support: thanks. Quick workaround: set "stream":false or double-escape backslashes in your input (i.e., send `\\` for each `\`). We'll escalate.

Zane (eng-ml): tagging in — this sounds like the JSON-mode streamer is splitting in the middle of an escape (e.g., emits `\` then `n` in next chunk) and our chunk stitching isn't re-escaping before forwarding. Repro steps look solid. I can reproduce locally with the payload. Adding fallback: buffer until a complete JSON token is observed before emitting. Raising PR.

Keisha (billing): is customer re-sent requests causing extra usage? If they retry, they'll be billed again. Let's note in ticket.

Mira - Support: created support ticket #SUP-1128 and bug #INF-457. Customer informed about workaround. Will monitor until fix deployed. :white_check_mark:

Zane (eng-ml): patch in review, targeted for next patch release. Interim fix: server-side can set header `X-structured-atomic:true` to force atomic response per message (we can enable per-customer if needed).

Emma (ACME): thanks, will try header and confirm. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
